nodes.name: PPMTDFOB synthesis
nodes.procedure: A flask was charged with N-methylpiperidine (1g) and anhydrous acetonitrile (ACN; 10 ml), chloromethyl methyl sulfide (1g) was added slowly, and the mixture was stirred at 60°C overnight with reflux. Then, LiDFOB was added, and the mixture was stirred for 6 hours. A precipitate of LiCl was also instantly formed, the LiCl was removed by filtration, and the volatiles were removed under vacuum to yield yellow oil.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of PPMTDFOB ILs ... A flask was charged with N-methylpiperidine (1g) and anhydrous acetonitrile (ACN; 10 ml) ... yield yellow oil.

nodes.name: PPMTPF6 synthesis
nodes.procedure: A flask was charged with N-methylpiperidine (1g) and ACN (10ml), chloromethyl methyl sulfide (1g) was added slowly, and the mixture was stirred at 60°C overnight with reflux. Then, LiPF6 was added, and the mixture was stirred for 6 hours. A precipitate of LiCl was also instantly formed, the LiCl was removed by filtration, and the volatiles were removed under vacuum to yield powder compounds.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of PPMTPF6 ILs ... A flask was charged with N-methylpiperidine (1g) and ACN (10ml) ... yield powder compounds.

nodes.name: PDOL QSSE preparation
nodes.procedure: 600 μl of monomer DOL, 0.151 g of LiPF6, and 0.144 g of LiDFOB were added to the solvent (200 μl of EDE and 200 μl of FEC), and the mixture was stirred vigorously to form a homogeneous solution. The presence of FEC and LiDFOB induce the formation of fluorine-rich interphases, contributing to enhanced interfacial stability. The EDE has lower viscosity and higher dielectric constant, which effectively improves the migration rate of lithium ions. Next, the mixture is quickly injected into the assembled 2032-coin cell until the Celgard 2500 is fully permeated. The electrolytes were then kept at room temperature for 24 hours to ensure that DOL was fully polymerized, referred to as PDOL.

nodes.name: PDOL@PPMTDFOB QSSE preparation
nodes.procedure: Using the same method as PDOL preparation (600 μl of monomer DOL, 0.151 g of LiPF6, and 0.144 g of LiDFOB were added to the solvent (200 μl of EDE and 200 μl of FEC), stirred vigorously to form homogeneous solution, injected into assembled 2032-coin cell until Celgard 2500 fully permeated, kept at room temperature for 24 hours), the electrolytes with 5 wt% PPMTDFOB ILs added were named PDOL@PPMTDFOB.

nodes.description: Li/Li symmetric cell plating/stripping stability at 0.2 mA/cm²
nodes.source_text: the Li|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li cells can stably cycle for more than 2650 hours at a current density and capacity of 0.2 mA cm⁻² and 0.2 mA·hour cm⁻² with a small polarization voltage of about 27 mV. In addition, the Li|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li battery exhibits a high critical current density of 2.0 mA cm⁻² with a stripping/plating period of 1 hour
NCM811|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li cell exhibits a remarkable reversible capacity of 123.3 mA·hour g⁻¹ at 1 C after 1100 cycles under a cutoff voltage of 4.3 V, with an impressive capacity retention of 80.5%
the NCM811/Li battery still exhibits outstanding cycling stability after 400 cycles at 1.0 C and a cutoff voltage of 4.5 V, with a capacity retention of 80.7% (from 155.1 to 125.2 mA·hour g⁻¹)
The LFP|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li battery shows a discharge capacity of 109.2 mA·hour g⁻¹ after 2600 cycles at 2 C and 30°C, with capacity decay of 0.0076% per cycle
NCM811|PDOL@PPMTPF₆ Li cell delivers a remarkable reversible capacity of 136.9 mA hour g⁻¹ at 1 C after 800 cycles under a cutoff voltage of 4.3 V, with an impressive capacity retention of 81.1%

nodes.characterization_summary: NCM811 particles remain intact after cycling with PDOL@PPMTDFOB, showing uniform thin CEI layer of 25 nm thickness, unlike fragmented particles with uneven thick CEI in PDOL.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NCM811 particles remain intact after being cycled in the PDOL@PPMTDFOB electrolyte ... a uniform thin layer of CEI with a thickness of 25 nm is also observed on the surface of the cycling NCM811 particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: NCM811 cathode shows serious fragmentation after cycling in PDOL electrolyte, while particles remain intact with PDOL@PPMTDFOB.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NCM811 cathode shows serious fragmentation after cycling in PDOL electrolyte ... In contrast, the NCM811 particles remain intact after being cycled in the PDOL@PPMTDFOB electrolyte.

nodes.characterization_summary: CEI of NCM811 with PDOL@PPMTDFOB shows lower organic C content (34.07% at 60 nm etching) and higher LiF ratio (32.78% at 60 nm etching) compared to PDOL; reduced Ni2+ and Ni0 concentrations indicate limited NiO rock salt phase formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The concentration of organic C atoms in CEI containing PDOL@PPMTDFOB (34.07% after etching depth of 60 nm) is lower than that in CEI containing PDOL (50.32%) ... The higher LiF ratio of the CEI containing PDOL@PPMTDFOB (32.78% after etching depth of 60 nm).

nodes.characterization_summary: CEI on NCM811 with PDOL@PPMTDFOB shows higher uniform LiF2- signal, lower organic CHO2- signal, smaller NiF3- and MnO2- signals indicating TM suppression, and SO2- signal from PPMTDFOB participation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: CEI derived from cell with PDOL@PPMTDFOB bears a higher and more uniform LiF2- signal strength and lower organic component signal strength (CHO2-) than PDOL ... the SO2- signal from PPMTDFOB is detected on the surface of NCM811.

nodes.characterization_summary: NCM811 cathode with PPMTDFOB shows R ratio of 1.25 vs 1.08 without, indicating less TM dissolution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The x-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern (Fig. 5L) shows that the R ratios without and with PPMTDFOB are 1.08 and 1.25, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Significantly lower Ni, Co, Mn dissolution into lithium anode for NCM811|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li compared to PDOL.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the content of Ni, Co, and Mn elements dissolved into the lithium anode in the NCM811|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li battery after cycling is significantly higher than that in the NCM811|PDOL|Li battery.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEI on deposited Li metal with PDOL@PPMTDFOB shows continuous dense layer ~31 nm thick with mosaic structure containing LiF, Li2CO3, Li2O, Li3N, Li2S nanocrystals; lattices identified at 2.04 Å (Li2S 220), 2.30 Å (LiF 111), 1.69 Å (Li3N 311).
nodes.evidence_snippet: a continuous and dense SEI with a thickness of ~31 nm grew on the deposited lithium metal surface using the PDOL@PPMTDFOB electrolyte ... the main lattices with calibrated interplanar spacings of 2.04 Å (Fig. 6K), 2.30 Å (fig. S20A), and 1.69 Å (fig. S20B) were captured.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEI on Li with PDOL@PPMTDFOB shows higher LiF concentration, presence of Li3N and Li2S species, increasing inorganic content (LiF, Li2O) with etching depth vs organic C decrease.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the lithium anode cycled with PDOL@PPMTDFOB exhibits a higher LiF concentration than that of PDOL ... Li3N and Li2S species are also formed in the SEI generated by PDOL@PPMTDFOB.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEI on Li with PDOL@PPMTDFOB shows higher LiF2-, LiO-, LiS-, LiN- signals and LiBO2- content vs lower organic CH3O- compared to PDOL.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Li|PDOL@PPMTDFOB|Li battery exhibits higher LiF (LiF2-) and Li2O (LiO-) contents in the SEI after cycling ... the signals of LiS- and LiN- appear in the SEI evolved by PPMTDFOB.

nodes.characterization_summary: Li metal anode surface after 100h cycling at 0.2 mA/cm² shows uniform roughness distribution with Ra = 11.6 nm for PDOL@PPMTDFOB vs 5.9 nm for PDOL, indicating uniform SEI formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: atomic force microscopy (AFM) test results show that the uniform surface roughness distribution and lower average roughness on the Li metal after cycling for 100 hours with 0.2 mA cm^{-2} (11.6 nm for PDOL@PPMTDFOB and 5.9 nm for PDOL) indicate the presence of a uniform SEI.
